_about: Atlas's designer list: video style -> its designer. Each entry is the designer skill path (relative to the Super Nova folder), or {"skill": <path>, "script": "none"} for a scriptless style. A plain path means the style needs a script. A row with a blank Style uses the default. A style whose name ends in "carousel" is a carousel style (output type carousel, the topic angle as its script; 2026-10-27). _aliases maps an old style name to its current one ("carousel" was renamed "corporate carousel" on 2026-10-27), so old sheets still read.
